description: Small, source-grounded regression set for explanation quality. Synthetic examples only.

expectations: A successful operation result is returned immediately.
A rejected operation enters the catch path.
When attempts is at most one, the current error is rethrown and retry stops.
Otherwise retry calls itself with attempts decremented by one.
The default of three permits at most three operation calls total.
An inactive user returns disabled before the ownership check.
The TODO does not implement shared-access authorization and its intended behavior is unspecified.

cases.source_text:
Quadratic formula for ax² + bx + c = 0, where a ≠ 0:
x = (-b ± √(b² - 4ac)) / (2a)
expectations: The plus-minus symbol represents two candidate calculations, one with plus and one with minus.
A positive discriminant gives two distinct real roots, zero gives one repeated real root, and a negative discriminant gives no real roots.
The formula requires a to be nonzero.

cases.source_text:
Upload retry policy

The client makes at most three attempts in total. It retries HTTP 429 and 5xx responses only. It waits 250 ms before the second attempt and 500 ms before the third. A Retry-After response header replaces the scheduled delay. Other 4xx responses are returned without retrying.
expectations: Three attempts total includes the initial attempt.
The scheduled waits are 250 ms and then 500 ms.
Other 4xx responses are returned without retry.
